## Checklist

- [ ] Fits the project scope (CONTRIBUTING.md → Scope)
- [ ] Builds warning-free (`-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror`, incl. LVGL deprecations) and from C++17
- [ ] No direct allocation; no private LVGL API or deprecated LVGL calls
- [ ] Public functions documented with their Figma / MD3 / CSS equivalent
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased* (if behaviour or API changed)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`) if user-facing behaviour changed
- [ ] Nothing company- or product-specific; no secrets
